summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only testing of NOVA wallet redesign (CRED-style): AbstractBalanceArt, theme toggle, cursive flourishes, and full flows. All critical user-facing flows PASS. Tests split per flow per note from previous iteration.

issues: Nav item labels ('home', 'rewards', etc.) render very faintly on the cream (#F5F2EA) background — contrast is borderline readable. Verify --ink-3 override for light theme yields sufficient contrast. No white-on-cream detected (whiteOnLight=0), but the greyscale still feels too light.

'Made with Emergent' badge (fixed bottom-right) overlaps the last two bottom-nav items (nav-vault and nav-profile). Playwright hit-testing lands on the badge anchor, not the NavLink. Real users on deployed env (no badge) are unaffected; JS .click() confirms navigation works. No app change required.

action_items: (Optional) Boost --ink-3 (or secondary nav text color) darkness in light theme for better contrast of bottom-nav labels.
(Testability) Add data-testid to the biometric toggle on /security (currently no [data-testid*=biometric] element exposed).
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeProvider (/app/frontend/src/lib/theme.jsx) is clean — uses data-theme on <html>, localStorage key 'nova_theme', default 'dark'. Persistence verified across reload.

AbstractBalanceArt is truly containerless — verified balance-art element has bg=rgba(0,0,0,0), border=0, borderRadius=0. Art layer is SVG only; type layer uses var(--ink)/--ink-2/--ink-3 so it re-themes. Gradient shapes (sun-grad orange→pink→indigo, blob-grad lime→cyan) remain saturated in both themes as intended.

All 5 success kinds (sent/backed_up/paid/claimed/redeemed) route correctly. Send success page shows 'sent.' with PaymentOrbit animation, to/network fee/total/txid receipt rows, back-to-home + view-all-transactions CTAs.

No #D4AF37 (gold) detected in live DOM across /home, /security, /store — score card uses lime gradient linear-gradient(135deg, #D4FF4F 0%, #7CFF8A 100%). Confetti.jsx still has '#D4AF37' as one of 8 random colors which is acceptable (ephemeral particles, not a brand color).

BottomNav uses NavLink + data-testid for each of 5 items. Labels: home, rewards, store, vault (→/security), you (→/profile). The 'vault' item routes to /security even though testid is nav-vault — matches spec.

No Instrument Serif italic or oxblood references found in src/. Italianno cursive confirmed as accent only (eyebrow 'the vault of', signature 'a quiet rebellion.', 'the tape', 'your story', 'welcome,'). Headlines use Clash Display.
test_credentials: Created fresh wallet per run: name='Aditya', PIN=123456 (cleared localStorage first).
seed_data_creation: None. Each test run onboards a fresh wallet; starting state 0.5 BTC / 25,000 coins / 12 gems supplied by backend mock.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All tests split per flow as requested. Testids verified: onboarding uses onboarding-pillars-next / onboarding-name-input / onboarding-name-next / onb-pin-key-{0-9} / onb-confirm-key-{0-9}. Home: balance-art, art-fiat, art-btc, art-change, art-name, home-greeting, theme-toggle. Profile: theme-toggle (1 instance) + 'the vault of' cursive. Send: send-address, send-amount, wheel-preset-{amt}, send-tier-{slow|average|fast}, send-next-btn, send-pin-key-{0-9}. Store cat pills: store-cat-{all|luxury|shop|travel|food|play} (NOT cat-*). Deep link /store?cat=food activates green lime pill bg=rgb(212,255,79). Transactions filter tabs: txn-filter-{all|sent|received|rewards}. Rewards claim: rewards-claim-btn. Bills: bill-biller-{Electricity|Internet|Mobile|Water|Rent}, bill-account, bill-amount, bill-pay-btn. Receive: receive-qr, receive-address, receive-amount, receive-copy, receive-share. Security: score-card uses lime gradient. PREVIEW-ONLY: Made-with-Emergent badge overlaps nav-vault/nav-profile — use `page.evaluate('() => document.querySelector("[data-testid=nav-profile]").click()')` or plain JS click instead of page.click for those two testids.
